name: A11y Starter Kit
summary: Free Next.js starter kit for WCAG 2.1 AA interfaces: accessible components, a11y hooks, dark mode.
description: A free, production-ready accessibility starter kit by thefrontkit for building WCAG 2.1 AA compliant interfaces with Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui. It ships demo pages (login, dashboard, data table, settings, notifications), accessibility hooks (useAnnounce, useFocusTrap, useKeyboardNavigation, useReducedMotion) and layout components (SkipLink, Header, Footer, Sidebar, MobileNav, ThemeToggle) with system-aware dark mode.
contains: demo pages: login, dashboard, data table, settings, notifications
custom hooks: useAnnounce, useFocusTrap, useKeyboardNavigation, useReducedMotion
components: LiveRegion, VisuallyHidden, SkipLink, Header, Footer, Sidebar, Breadcrumbs, MobileNav, ThemeToggle
keyboard navigation, ARIA landmarks, 44px touch targets and reduced-motion support
Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, React Hook Form + Zod, TanStack Table
